The '''Hijoian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Hijoian Space/Legends|Hijoian Space]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
The system was the location of the [[Hijoian Docks]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> where [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] saboteur [[Yansan]] destroyed two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
